name: Index Turn-of-Month Intraday Drift
hypothesis: Calendar anomaly: equity indices drift upward intraday on the last weekday and first three weekdays of each month (flow/rebalancing driven).
risk_model: One planned risk unit, long only; fixed 0.35 daily-ATR stop; 2.2R objective; entry after the first cash-session M15 candle; flat 15 minutes before the cash close.
known_limitations: No verified edge. Weekday calendar ignores exchange holidays; anomaly documented to have weakened after publication; three correlated indices on the same days.

authorship.statement: Created by this actual Claude Code session; not attributed to Codex or Kimi.
